# Draft:List of disabled Academy Award winners and nominees

This list details the disabled people who have been nominated for or received Academy Awards and/or actors who have been nominated or won for playing disabled characters. Individuals are identified as disabled, though they may not have been diagnosed or publicly identified as such at the time of their nomination; however, if the person acquired a disability later in life, only nominations after they became disabled should be listed.
